summary: Move vendor evaluation seats to Data Platform + enable cost-center tagging for billing exports
description:
Issue summary: Move 30 vendor evaluation seats (currently in central vendor-eval pool) to the Data Platform org for a 6-week proof-of-concept. Request also includes enabling cost-center tagging on billing exports so Finance can allocate spend to team cost centers.

Impact: Data Platform engineers currently using shared eval seats are pinned on temporary invites. Without seat migration they will hit user limits this week and the POC rollout (starting 2026-03-15) will be blocked. Finance needs cost-center tags to map vendor usage to the correct cost center for chargeback.

Background: Vendor (ObserveNexus) granted a 60-seat evaluation pool to Redwood. Data Platform needs 30 seats. Procurement previously approved reallocation but action requires identity team to provision SCIM-enabled group and billing team to add a custom dimension to the monthly CSV exports. Legal requested an EULA redline review for long-running evals. Security flagged a minimal posture checklist for vendor SSO.

Requirements:
- Transfer 30 seats from vendor-eval pool to Data Platform SSO group (SCIM provisioning preferred).
- Ensure seats provision with SSO via Okta and group assignment at creation.
- Add a "cost_center" column to the monthly billing CSV for this vendor and ensure the new seats are tagged with cost center 4201-DataPlat.
- Legal to confirm EULA redline is acceptable for a 6-week extended evaluation.
- Security to sign off on the vendor minimal posture checklist (IP allowlist, audit logging, SOC2 evidence link).

Requested timeline: seat migration completed by 2026-03-14; billing tag applied for March export; legal/security approvals by 2026-03-13.

Owner: Procurement (Ava) coordinating with Identity (Marco), Finance (Liz Chen), Security (Samir Nath), Legal (Priya Kaur).
comments: Ava Patel (Procurement) - 2026-03-10: Created ticket after Data Platform reported blocked onboarding. Please advise if SCIM group creation requires a support contract change with ObserveNexus.
Marco Ruiz (Identity) - 2026-03-11: Identity can create an Okta group and push via SCIM. Need vendor's SCIM schema and a test user. Can we get an admin invite from vendor?

Liz Chen (Finance) - 2026-03-11: Finance confirms we need a cost_center column on the CSV. We can backfill the March export if tagging is applied to seats before the export cutoff (end of day 2026-03-14).
investigation_notes: Confirmed vendor (ObserveNexus) supports SCIM group provisioning; vendor docs and API token were requested from procurement.

Checked existing billing export schema for other SaaS vendors; existing pipeline supports custom columns via mapping file. Finance to supply mapping id (s3://redwood-billing/mappings/observe_nexus.json).
Security requested a minimal posture checklist; current responses: SOC2 link provided, IP allowlist pending, 2 admin users need MFA enforcement.
resolution_notes: Pending: vendor to provide SCIM schema and admin invite. Identity will run a dry-provision on staging (IDP test org).
Finance will enable cost_center field in March export once seats are tagged; billing automation PR drafted (see related_github_prs).
Legal review queued; Priya will provide final approval or redline by 2026-03-13.
